_about: The 2026 Chicago Cubs, regular season and postseason, from MLB's own published schedule (statsapi.mlb.com, fetched 10/1/26). The regular season (3/26-9/27) is complete: all 162 games with results, first-pitch times converted to Chicago time, TV the Cubs' Chicago carrier (Marquee) plus any national network, or the national network alone where it was exclusive (a national game blacked out in Chicago is left out). Three postponed games are stored on the dates they were made up and played (4/5 at Cleveland, 6/24 at the Mets, 8/6 vs Toronto); a game 2 of a doubleheader the league never timed has no start. The Cubs lost the NL Wild Card Series at San Diego 0-2 (9/29, 9/30); their 2026 season is over.
